constructed_story: As a driver, I want the ADAS to adapt its forward collision avoidance behavior based on my driving intention and behavior, so that I can experience safer and more personalized driving assistance that is better accepted by me.

As a Virginia public health official, I want recommend mobile vaccination site placement in real-time to target under‑vaccinated populations, so that increase vaccine uptake among hesitant groups and reduce the risk of new variants.
As a music curator, I want to predict the success of playlists using a machine learning-based approach, so that to enhance playlist creation and improve the music listening experience for users.

As a Transportation Planner, I want Predict hourly taxi and Uber ridership per zip-code area using an XGBoost model, so that Enable optimal taxi dispatch and city planning decisions by accurately estimating demand.
As a Neonatal nurse, I want identify unhealthy newborns using a non-invasive cry diagnostic system, so that enable early detection and timely intervention for neonatal health issues.

As a Data Scientist, I want develop a methodology to quantify political bias in tweets using a bias subspace approach, so that provide insights into political bias patterns and support fairer ML models.
As a data scientist, I want build predictive models for drug abuse using personality traits and demographic data, so that to enable early intervention and prevention of drug abuse.
As a dermatologist, I want detect and classify skin lesions accurately using a deep learning model, so that improve early detection of skin cancer and patient outcomes.
